title: The Drive That Starts OVER 🚗
description:
On our road, there's one question you never ask in the car. Ask it, and the whole drive starts over from mile one.

Every summer Mom drives my big sister and me out to our aunt's farm. This year we've passed the same red barn thirty-seven times, and neither of us has said a word.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
